domain-information: As an attendee, I want to register for trainings and summits with limited seating, so that I can secure my spot.
As a training coordinator, I want to monitor attendance and manage cancellations, so that seats are used efficiently and refunds are handled correctly.
As a trainer, I want to view and manage my training details, including attendees and shared materials, so that I can prepare effectively.
As an attendee, I want to be placed on a waitlist for full trainings, so that I still have a chance to participate if space opens up.
As a trainee, I want to view my personalized schedule and registered sessions, so that I can plan my days at the event.
As an administrator, I want to define venues, rooms, and schedules, so that all events have a clear time and location.
As a summit coordinator, I want to describe my summit and list sponsors, agenda, and speakers, so that potential attendees understand its value.
As a sponsor, I want to select sponsorship levels that align with my budget and goals, so that I gain visibility among attendees.
As an attendee, I want to indicate my company affiliation, so that others can connect with me.
As a content administrator, I want to publish content about the event, so that the community stays informed.
As an attendee, I want to read event content, so that I can stay updated on event news.
As an administrator, I want to manage payments and refunds for sponsorships, so that finances are accurate and transparent.
As a session submitter, I want to submit talks or trainings and receive feedback on acceptance, so that I can participate as a speaker.
As an administrator, I want to approve and publish submissions for sessions into the schedule, so that the program reflects finalized decisions.

domain objects.name: Attendee
domain objects.desc: Person taking part in trainings, summits, or sessions.

domain objects.name: Company
domain objects.desc: Organization an attendee or sponsor represents.

domain objects.name: Registration
domain objects.desc: Record that signs an attendee up for an event.

domain objects.name: Cancellation
domain objects.desc: Record of a registration being canceled.

domain objects.name: Event
domain objects.desc: Generic scheduled activity (training or summit).

domain objects.name: Training
domain objects.desc: Hands-on instructional event led by a trainer.

domain objects.name: Shared Materials
domain objects.desc: Files or slides trainers share with attendees.

domain objects.name: Summit
domain objects.desc: Themed discussion event with speakers and sponsors.

domain objects.name: Sponsor
domain objects.desc: Entity providing financial support.

domain objects.name: Sponsorship Level
domain objects.desc: Tier that defines sponsor benefits and price.

domain objects.name: Sponsor Company
domain objects.desc: The company representing a sponsor.

domain objects.name: Agenda
domain objects.desc: Planned list of topics or timed items.

domain objects.name: Speaker
domain objects.desc: Person presenting at a session or summit.

domain objects.name: Venue
domain objects.desc: Physical location where events occur.

domain objects.name: Time
domain objects.desc: Date and duration assigned to an event.

domain objects.name: Wait List
domain objects.desc: Queue of people waiting for an open seat.

domain objects.name: Attendee List
domain objects.desc: List of attendees that are allowed in for the event

domain objects.name: Schedule
domain objects.desc: Mapping of events to times and rooms.

domain objects.name: Training Coordinator
domain objects.desc: Person who manages training logistics.

domain objects.name: Trainer
domain objects.desc: Instructor responsible for a training.

domain objects.name: Administrator
domain objects.desc: Role that configures events, payments, and approvals.

domain objects.name: Summit Coordinator
domain objects.desc: Person organizing summit details and sponsors.

domain objects.name: Payment
domain objects.desc: Money transfer made for sponsorship or registration.

domain objects.name: Refund
domain objects.desc: Reversal of a previous payment.

domain objects.name: Content Administrator
domain objects.desc: Person publishing event-related content.

domain objects.name: Event Content
domain objects.desc: Articles or announcements about the event.

domain objects.name: Session Submitter
domain objects.desc: User proposing a session or training.

domain objects.name: Session Submission
domain objects.desc: Proposal for a session awaiting approval.

associations.desc: Attendee creates a Registration to join an Event.
Attendee triggers a Cancellation to withdraw from an Event.
Registration links an Attendee to an Event.
Cancellation refers to the Event being canceled.
Attendee joins a Summit as a participant.
Attendee joins a Training as a learner.
Schedule organizes Events by time and venue.
Administrator manages the Schedule of Events.
Training Coordinator manages details for a Training Event.
Trainer leads a Training and provides Shared Materials.
Session Submitter creates a Session Submission for review.
Administrator reviews and approves a Session Submission.
Content Administrator captures information about the Event
Sponsor makes a Payment to support the Event.
Sponsor may receive a Refund if a Payment is reversed.
Administrator processes a Payment from a Sponsor.
Administrator authorizes a Refund for a Sponsor.
